title: Requiem and Holy Week
readingOutcome: Read Requiem and Holy Week texts without treating special-rite vocabulary as normal-Proper frequency.

sources.section: Introit excerpt — antiphon and psalm verse; repeated antiphon omitted
sources.sourceLatin: Requiem aeternam dona eis, Domine: et lux perpetua luceat eis. Te decet hymnus, Deus, in Sion: et tibi reddetur votum in Jerusalem: exaudi orationem meam, ad te omnis caro veniet.

textAudit.note: Checked against pinned Requiem Mass corpus. Repeated antiphon/refrain material not needed for the reading exercise is omitted from sourceLatin.

sources.section: Offertory excerpt — final repeated Quam olim refrain omitted
sources.sourceLatin: Domine Iesu Christe, Rex gloriae, libera animas omnium fidelium defunctorum de poenis inferni et de profundo lacu: libera eas de ore leonis, ne absorbeat eas tartarus, ne cadant in obscurum: sed signifer sanctus Michael repraesentet eas in lucem sanctam: quam olim Abrahae promisisti et semini ejus. Hostias et preces tibi, Domine, laudis offerimus: tu suscipe pro animabus illis, quarum hodie memoriam facimus: fac eas, Domine, de morte transire ad vitam.

textAudit.note: Checked against pinned Requiem Mass corpus. Repeated antiphon/refrain material not needed for the reading exercise is omitted from sourceLatin.

specializedRegisterFramework.rule: Read accurately while keeping specialized frequency partitioned.

learnerCopy.en: Requiem and Holy Week contain crucial vocabulary that is comparatively rare in normal Propers.
learnerCopy.fr: Le Requiem et la Semaine sainte contiennent un vocabulaire crucial mais relativement rare dans les propres ordinaires.

learnerCopy.en: requies is the semantic center of the Introit; the surrounding syntax is already familiar.
learnerCopy.fr: requies est le centre semantique de l'Introit ; la syntaxe environnante est deja familiere.

learnerCopy.en: defunctorum is genitive plural: of the faithful departed.
learnerCopy.fr: defunctorum est un genitif pluriel : des fideles defunts.

learnerCopy.en: Crucis is genitive singular of crux: the wood of the Cross.
learnerCopy.fr: Crucis est le genitif singulier de crux : le bois de la Croix.

learnerCopy.en: The Reproaches use direct address and rhetorical questions.
learnerCopy.fr: Les Improperes emploient l'adresse directe et les questions rhetoriques.

learnerCopy.en: Understand the specialized text while preserving the distinction between special-rite and ordinary vocabulary.
learnerCopy.fr: Comprenez le texte specialise tout en gardant la distinction entre vocabulaire special et vocabulaire ordinaire.
